section: Google Workspace and Google Meet features, Meet-Certified Devices and Google Beam demos
body:
This brief summarizes what AVI-SPL's Google page says the Google platform offers, for a consultant helping a customer compare meeting platforms and devices. It covers Google Workspace, Google Meet capabilities, Meet-Certified Devices and Google Beam.

**Google Workspace components**
The suite spans meetings, chat, calendars, conference rooms, email and team productivity solutions:
- Google Meet: secure video meetings to keep teams connected.
- Calendar: calendars that can be shared and that work with Gmail, Drive, Meet and other Google tools.
- Productivity software: chat, email, Docs and more.
- Security and management: admin control from one central place, endpoint management to secure data, and Vault for retaining data.
- Work Insights: tracking of usage and adoption.

**Google Meet capabilities as described**
- AI-powered video conferencing: Gemini in Meet takes notes, translates conversations in real time and fixes poor video/audio.
- Hybrid participation: collaboration with teams of any size from any device, at home, in the office or elsewhere.
- Security and data protections: host controls described as advanced, anti-abuse measures, and encryption on by default.
- Enterprise-ready: the page says moving to Meet can reduce subscription costs and simplify management through the Workspace Admin console.
- Collaboration tools: third-party tools can be brought into a meeting, such as whiteboarding apps from Figma, LucidSpark, Miro and others.
- Meet-Certified Devices: the portfolio includes room kits and all-in-one collaboration devices for setting up personal and team spaces.

**Google Beam**
- The page says Google partnered with HP on technology that makes remote conversations feel like being in the same room, with no additional glasses or headsets.
- Google Beam creates this sense of presence using advances in AI, 3D imaging and other technologies. Its light field display produces a sense of volume and depth.
- Google is working to enable Beam directly from video conferencing services in use today, such as Google Meet and Zoom. The page words this as work in progress, not as a finished capability.
- AVI-SPL can schedule a demo at a Google location.

**When to use this**
For questions about what Google Meet and Google Workspace include, whether Meet has AI features, what kinds of certified room devices exist, or how to see Google Beam.

**Not stated in this source**
No device models or manufacturers for Meet-Certified Devices, no license or pricing detail, and no Beam availability date.
